brief:
Gaza families face imminent hunger as the United Nations reduces food assistance due to funding shortages, Middle East Eye reported. The cuts will leave approximately half a million people without critical aid as food prices surge across the territory.

The reduction threatens to trigger another famine crisis in Gaza, where malnutrition and food insecurity have already reached severe levels. Families are bracing for deepened hardship as the assistance withdrawal coincides with escalating food costs.

title: UN cuts Gaza food aid as famine fears mount
